events.title: Demo Update v0.1.5 - Combo Buildings, Demolish and more
events.summary: New update for the Divinestead Demo, addressing a few requests from the feedback, such as video settings and a demolish option on buildings, as well as a new type of building to spice up the gameplay and give value to where players decide to build!This new type of building gives meaning to how you place your buildings, and enables some combos as well. events.title: Hey settlers, the Divinestead Demo is now live!
events.summary: Settlers, it's time to claim new lands!The Divinestead Demo is officially live and playable on Steam 🏰This demo covers the early game and offers around ~2 hours of content, but you can keep playing and expanding for as long as you'd like!If you have any feedback, bug reports, or general impressions, please drop a comment: your input helps shape the game.If you enjoy the demo, please consider adding Divinestead to your Steam Wishlist, it helps a lot!Hope you all enjoy the demo!
